quiz.question: Which Indian state has recently enacted the draft Women Farmers Empowerment Bill 2026 to legally recognize women farmers regardless of land ownership?
quiz.explanation: The draft Maharashtra Women Farmers Empowerment Bill 2026 legally recognizes women engaged in agriculture, regardless of their land ownership status. This legal recognition will enable women farmers to independently access government welfare schemes, loans, subsidies, and agricultural insurance benefits.

quiz.question: In July 2026, the Maharashtra Cabinet expanded the scope of its Punyashlok Ahilyadevi Holkar loan waiver scheme, raising the cap of dues to be waived off to how much?
quiz.explanation: The Maharashtra Cabinet raised the debt waiver cap of its Punyashlok Ahilyadevi Holkar loan waiver scheme to Rs 2 lakh from the previously set Rs 50,000. This modification will allow farmers who had already benefited from the 2019 Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Loan Waiver Scheme to cover their subsequent defaults under the larger Rs 2 lakh threshold.

quiz.question: In June 2026, the Maharashtra State Cabinet approved an administrative restructuring to expand the number of administrative departments from 33 to how many?
quiz.explanation: The Maharashtra Cabinet approved a major restructuring of its administrative framework, increasing the number of departments from 33 to 45. The expansion aims to diversify the workload on departments handling multiple subjects, streamlining the distribution of manpower and work.

quiz.question: Which program was approved by the Union Cabinet in July 2026 with an outlay of Rs. 1,27,500 crore to accelerate the semiconductor design and manufacturing ecosystem in India?
quiz.explanation: The Union Cabinet approved the next phase of the Semicon India Programme, known as Semicon 2.0, with a total budget outlay of Rs. 1,27,500 crore. Building on Semicon 1.0 (which had an outlay of Rs. 76,000 crore), Semicon 2.0 covers chip design, manufacturing, materials, advanced packaging, and skilled talent development.

quiz.question: With reference to the National Investment Policy (NIP) for Urea-2026 approved in July 2026, which of the following is a key objective of the policy?
options: To promote coal-based urea manufacturing plants exclusively
To transition all urea manufacturing completely to organic liquid urea
To establish 8 to 9 new natural gas-based fertilizer plants and add 10 million tonnes of indigenous urea capacity
To phase out urea imports entirely by placing a 100% tariff on foreign chemical fertilizers
quiz.explanation: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) approved the National Investment Policy (NIP) for Urea-2026 to promote self-reliance in the fertilizer sector. The policy aims to boost domestic production of urea by setting up 8 to 9 new natural gas-based plants and adding 10 million tonnes of fresh indigenous urea capacity.

quiz.question: Which diplomatic framework did India unveil in July 2026 at the UN headquarters to guide its campaign for a non-permanent seat in the UN Security Council for the 2028-29 term?
quiz.explanation: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar launched India's campaign for a non-permanent seat on the UN Security Council (UNSC) for the 2028-29 term under the 'SHANTI' vision. SHANTI stands for 'Securing Holistic Advancement through Norms, Trust and Integrity', which emphasizes reforming multilateralism and amplifying the Global South.

quiz.question: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) recently launched the NIDAR 2.0 challenge under the SwaYaan initiative. Which indigenous microprocessor is mandated to be used for component innovation in this challenge?
quiz.explanation: MeitY launched the second edition of the National Innovation Challenge for Drone Application and Research (NIDAR 2.0) in collaboration with the Drone Federation of India. The hardware track of the challenge requires engineering student teams to build indigenous flight controllers using the open-standard 'VEGA' microprocessor, developed by C-DAC.

quiz.question: Which section of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023, governs the procedure for conducting a 'Trial in Absentia' against absconding proclaimed offenders?
quiz.explanation: Section 356 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023, outlines the legal framework and robust safeguards for conducting trials in absentia against proclaimed offenders who abscond to evade justice. This was recently initiated in a special NIA court against LeT chief Hafiz Saeed.

quiz.question: In July 2026, Union Minister Bhupender Yadav inaugurated the national-level Centre of Excellence (CoE) on Human-Wildlife Conflict at which of the following institutions?
options: National Board for Wildlife, New Delhi
quiz.explanation: Union Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav inaugurated the national-level Centre of Excellence (CoE) on Human-Wildlife Conflict at the Wildlife Institute of India-Sálim Ali Centre for Ornithology and Natural History (WII-SACON) in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. The CoE will serve as a hub for research, capacity building, and evidence-based management of human-wildlife conflict.

quiz.question: Which union ministry has recently released the first-ever trial monthly Index of Services Production (ISP) for April 2026 with 2024-25 as the base year?
options: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
quiz.explanation: The Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) launched the first-ever trial Index of Services Production (ISP) with 2024-25 as the base year. The new macroeconomic indicator tracks monthly changes in the volume of services output, complementing the Index of Industrial Production (IIP).
